stories.summary: Report identity: the skill, skills commit SHA, input and output branches and exact agent-image, step-kit and verifier versions on the run report, with not-recorded and access-denied states
Report verdicts: the claimed verdict, the final verdict after verification and every L0/L1/L2 check result, including overturned, verification-not-run and unavailable-record states
Report diff: capture the baseline-to-output-branch diff once after the run and render its files, counts and patches, pinned to the recorded head and showing empty or unavailable states
Report Jira changes: capture the configured Jira project's before/after state, persist field-level changes with the run and render them, tolerating no integration or an unavailable tracker
Report turns and trace: show the recorded turn count and, when tracing is enabled and a trace identifier exists, link to the run's trace
